title: Claude-thermos keeps your Claude session warm for you
claim: Show HN: Claude-thermos keeps your Claude session warm for you
why_good: Keeps a Claude Code session 'warm' to cut cold-start latency — a real micro-annoyance for heavy agent users.
value: Thin; a paid pro/team utility at best, or it stays a free convenience.
risk: A tiny wrapper the vendors can obsolete by improving cold-starts; feature, not a company.

zh.claim: Show HN: Claude-thermos —— 帮你保持 Claude 会话温热。
zh.why_good: 让 Claude Code 会话保持温热以减少冷启动延迟——对重度 agent 用户是真实的小烦恼。
zh.value: 很薄;顶多做付费专业/团队小工具,否则就是免费便利。
zh.risk: 一个厂商改进冷启动就能作废的薄封装;是功能不是公司。
